datasets.name: IPN HandS (annotations + GT landmarks + MPHands landmarks)
datasets.audit_notes: 200 videos (801,476 frames, 640x480 @ 30fps), 15 classes. Official 148/52 split has 0 scene+person overlap (37/13) but overlaps 8 person_ids (1,2,3,12,13,15,18,21). Custom person_id-disjoint split required for training to prevent leakage.

datasets.name: A dataset of egocentric and exocentric view hands in interactive senses (2024, v2) - 2 slice zips
datasets.audit_notes: Raw 1280x720 RGB frames only (no MediaPipe or Sketchbook gesture ground truth). Full dataset has 24 zips (8.78 GB); only 2 slices kept due to 4.8 GiB free disk.
